title: AgentOnto: Ontology-Guided LLM Agents for Enterprise Data Analytics

paragraphs.en: Enterprise data analysis requires agents to connect analytical requests with knowledge distributed across databases, business documents, and existing example tasks. Without an explicit representation of this knowledge, an agent may produce incorrect analytical results and cannot reliably incorporate feedback. We present AgentOnto, an ontology-guided LLM agent for enterprise data analytics. AgentOnto organizes heterogeneous enterprise knowledge into an ontology that directly guides analysis and incorporates confirmed feedback. Iterative Ontology Preparation further improves the ontology through self-generated analysis tasks. We evaluate AgentOnto on two public data sources. AgentOnto substantially outperforms representative methods, while module-level evaluations confirm the effectiveness of ontology construction, analysis, and updating. A real-world deployment further demonstrates its practical value in enterprise analytics. These results demonstrate that explicitly constructing, using, and updating enterprise knowledge supports reliable and adaptable data analysis.

paragraphs.en: Enterprise decision-making increasingly depends on data analysis. As enterprise data sources, business knowledge, and analytical requirements grow, predefined dashboards and fixed workflows can no longer meet the breadth and complexity of analytical needs. Large language model (LLM) agents offer a flexible analytical interface by combining language understanding, reasoning, database access, and tool use. Recent enterprise business-intelligence systems, including SiriusBI ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) and CoeusBI ( Lian et al., 2026 ) , demonstrate the practical value of this agent-based approach for enterprise analytics.

paragraphs.en: However, accurate enterprise analytics requires an agent to identify the relevant business entities and relationships and apply them correctly to the available data. Ontologies provide explicit conceptual models that organize this business knowledge and connect it to enterprise databases. Ontology-based data access systems such as SODA ( Blunschi et al., 2012 ) and ATHENA ( Saha et al., 2016 ; Sen et al., 2020 ) use these models and mappings to translate user questions into database operations ( Xiao et al., 2018 ) . In parallel, LLM data-analysis agents extend natural-language querying with planning, tool invocation, and execution feedback, and recent work uses LLMs to construct ontologies or reusable knowledge ( Giglou et al., 2023 ; Rissaki et al., 2024 ) . These studies connect ontologies to enterprise data, enabling broader analytical capabilities for agents. Despite these advances, building ontology-guided agents for enterprise analytics still presents three key challenges.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，准确的企业分析需要智能体能够识别相关的业务实体和关系，并将其正确应用于可用数据。 本体论提供了明确的概念模型，用于组织这些业务知识并将其与企业数据库连接起来。 基于本体论的数据访问系统（如 SODA (Blunschi et al., 2012) 和 ATHENA (Saha et al., 2016; Sen et al., 2020)）利用这些模型和映射，将用户问题转换为数据库操作 (Xiao et al., 2018)。 与此同时，LLM 数据分析智能体通过规划、工具调用和执行反馈扩展了自然语言查询功能，近期的研究还利用 LLM 构建本体论或可重用的知识 (Giglou et al., 2023; Rissaki et al., 2024)。 这些研究将本体论与企业数据连接起来，从而为智能体提供了更广泛的分析能力。 尽管取得了这些进展，构建以本体论为指导的企业分析智能体仍然面临三个关键挑战。

paragraphs.en: (1) Heterogeneous Sources Complicate Ontology Construction. Enterprise analytics knowledge is distributed across databases, business documents, and existing example tasks, which respectively describe data structure, business concepts, and analysis patterns. A well-constructed enterprise analytics ontology integrates knowledge from these sources around entities and relationships with supporting evidence. Existing methods, however, typically focus on individual sources ( Oyewale and Soru, 2026 ) or ontology components ( Lippolis et al., 2025 ) , providing limited support for integrating heterogeneous evidence.
paragraphs.zh: (1) 异构数据源使本体构建复杂化。 企业分析知识分布在数据库、业务文档和现有示例任务中，这些资源分别描述了数据结构、业务概念和分析模式。 一个构建良好的企业分析本体能够围绕实体与关系，结合支持性证据整合来自这些来源的知识。 然而，现有方法通常仅关注单一数据源（Oyewale 和 Soru, 2026）或本体组件（Lippolis 等, 2025），对异构证据的整合仅提供有限支持。

paragraphs.en: (2) Insufficient Ontology Integration Constrains Agent Analytics. Providing an ontology to an agent does not ensure correct analytical behavior. Effective ontology updating should therefore correct the targeted problem while preserving analytical behavior that should remain unchanged.

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges, we present AgentOnto , an ontology-guided LLM agent for enterprise data analytics. AgentOnto integrates ontology construction, data analysis, and ontology updating into a unified workflow, with an enterprise analytics ontology guiding the entire process. (i) Ontology Construction integrates knowledge from enterprise data, business documents, and existing example tasks into an enterprise analytics ontology with supporting evidence. (ii) Ontology-Guided Analysis uses the ontology to guide plan formation, checking, and execution. (iii) Ontology Updating turns confirmed feedback into targeted changes and verifies that the target problem is corrected while other established behavior is preserved. Building on these methods, AgentOnto introduces Iterative Ontology Preparation , which uses self-generated analysis tasks to examine and refine the ontology before handling actual analysis tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 AgentOnto——一种基于本体论指导的大型语言模型智能体，专用于企业数据分析。 AgentOnto 将本体论构建、数据分析和本体论更新整合到统一的工作流程中，并由企业分析本体论指导整个流程。 (i) 本体论构建：将来自企业数据、业务文档和现有示例任务的知识整合到企业分析本体论中，并附上支持性证据。 (ii) 基于本体论的指导分析：利用本体论指导计划的制定、验证与执行。 (iii) 本体论更新：将已确认的反馈转化为有针对性的修改，并验证目标问题是否得到纠正，同时保留其他既定行为。 在这些方法的基础上，AgentOnto 引入了迭代本体论准备机制，该机制利用自生成的分析任务来检验和优化本体论，然后再处理实际的分析任务。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate AgentOnto using public data from two sources: the World Development Indicators (WDI) and the U.S. EPA Air Quality System (AQS). We compare it with methods based on static ontologies, multi-stage SQL generation, and database-agent tool use. AgentOnto achieves an analysis accuracy of 87.5%, compared with 55.0% for the strongest baseline. Evaluations of the three core methods further show that AgentOnto improves ontology construction, analysis, and updating across both domains. Taken together, these results show that an explicit enterprise analytics ontology can improve reliability across related requests by guiding analysis and incorporating changes in business requirements. We further quantify AgentOnto through a real-world deployment, demonstrating its ability to support reliable and adaptable enterprise data analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用来自两个来源的公开数据来评估 AgentOnto：世界发展指标（WDI）和美国 环保署空气质量系统（AQS）。 我们将它与基于静态本体、多阶段 SQL 生成以及数据库-智能体工具使用的方法进行了比较。 AgentOnto 的分析准确率达到 87.5%，而最强的基线方法仅为 55.0%。 对三种核心方法的进一步评估表明，AgentOnto 在两个领域都改进了本体构建、分析和更新。 综合来看，这些结果表明，一个明确的商业分析本体可以通过指导分析并融入业务需求的变化，来提高相关请求的可靠性。 我们还通过实际部署对 AgentOnto 进行了量化评估，证明了其支持可靠且适应性强的企业数据分析的能力。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 presents the AgentOnto framework, which consists of three core methods. Ontology Construction integrates the enterprise resources into an ontology containing entities and relationships, metric definitions, and database mappings, with supporting evidence for each entry. Given an analytical request, Ontology-Guided Analysis uses the ontology to form and check an analysis plan, connect the plan to the database, and produce the analytical result. When confirmed feedback reveals an ontology problem, Ontology Updating makes a targeted change and verifies both the intended correction and the analytical behavior that should remain unchanged. Building on these methods, Iterative Ontology Preparation uses self-generated analysis tasks to examine and refine the constructed ontology before actual requests are handled.
paragraphs.zh: 图 2 展示了 AgentOnto 框架，该框架由三种核心方法组成。 本体构建将企业资源整合到一个包含实体与关系、指标定义和数据库映射的本体中，并为每个条目提供支撑证据。 给定一个分析请求，本体引导分析会利用该本体来制定和验证分析计划，将计划与数据库连接，并生成分析结果。 当确认的反馈揭示出本体问题时，本体更新会进行针对性修改，并验证预期的修正以及应保持不变的分析行为。 基于这些方法，迭代本体准备利用自生成的分析任务，在实际处理请求之前对构建好的本体进行检查和优化。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the complete AgentOnto workflow and its three core methods through four research questions:
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过四个研究问题来评估完整的 AgentOnto 工作流程及其三种核心方法：

paragraphs.en: RQ1 (Overall Effectiveness): How effectively does the complete AgentOnto workflow handle enterprise analysis requests?
paragraphs.zh: RQ1（整体有效性）：完整的 AgentOnto 工作流程处理企业分析请求的有效性如何？

paragraphs.en: RQ2 (Ontology Construction): To what extent does Ontology Construction organize heterogeneous enterprise knowledge into an ontology that connects to data and supports analysis?
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题2（本体构建）：本体构建在多大程度上能够将异构的企业知识组织成一个与数据相连并支持分析的本体？

paragraphs.en: RQ3 (Ontology-Guided Analysis): Given a fixed ontology, how does Ontology-Guided Analysis affect the correctness of analytical decisions and execution?
paragraphs.zh: RQ3（本体引导分析）：给定一个固定的本体，本体引导分析如何影响分析决策和执行的正确性？

paragraphs.en: RQ4 (Ontology Updating): Can Ontology Updating correct a targeted problem while preserving analytical behavior that should remain unchanged?
paragraphs.zh: RQ4（本体更新）：本体更新能否在保持本应不变的分析行为的同时，修正特定的问题？

paragraphs.en: Compared Methods. We compare AgentOnto Construction with Single-Prompt LLM, OntoEKG ( Oyewale and Soru, 2026 ) , Memoryless CQ-by-CQ ( Lippolis et al., 2025 ) , and Ontop ( Calvanese et al., 2016 ) . We distinguish ontology content, which includes entities, relationships, and metric definitions, from database mappings, which connect this knowledge to tables and columns. AgentOnto Construction and Single-Prompt LLM construct both parts. OntoEKG and Memoryless CQ-by-CQ construct ontology content without database mappings, while Ontop constructs database mappings from the database schema.
paragraphs.zh: 对比方法。 我们将 AgentOnto Construction 与 Single-Prompt LLM、OntoEKG（Oyewale 和 Soru，2026）、Memoryless CQ-by-CQ（Lippolis 等，2025）以及 Ontop（Calvanese 等，2016）进行了对比。 我们将本体内容（包括实体、关系和度量定义）与数据库映射（将这一知识与表及列连接起来）区分开来。 AgentOnto Construction 和 Single-Prompt LLM 都会构建这两部分。 OntoEKG 和 Memoryless CQ-by-CQ 仅构建本体内容，不包含数据库映射；而 Ontop 则从数据库模式构建数据库映射。

paragraphs.en: Results. AgentOnto achieves ontology-content F1 of 93.6% on WDI and 76.7% on AQS. It passes 43/51 WDI and 29/42 AQS database-connection tests, corresponding to 84.3% and 69.0%. Compared with Single-Prompt LLM, AgentOnto improves content F1 by 10.6 and 17.6 points and database-connection accuracy by 41.2 and 21.4 percentage points across the two domains. The improvements in analysis accuracy are smaller at 2.1 points on WDI and 1.9 points on AQS, showing that the largest gains occur in the constructed ontology and its connection to data.
paragraphs.zh: 结果。 AgentOnto 在 WDI 上的本体内容 F1 值为 93.6%，在 AQS 上为 76.7%。 它通过了 43/51 项 WDI 测试和 29/42 项 AQS 数据库连接测试，分别对应 84.3% 和 69.0% 的准确率。 与 Single-Prompt LLM 相比，AgentOnto 在这两个领域的内容 F1 值分别提升了 10.6 和 17.6 个百分点，数据库连接准确率则分别提升了 41.2 和 21.4 个百分点。 分析准确率的提升较小，WDI 上为 2.1 个百分点，AQS 上为 1.9 个百分点，这表明最大的改进体现在所构建的本体及其与数据的连接上。

We also report answer coverage, the proportion of requests receiving executable results. Higher coverage does not necessarily indicate better analysis because not every request should be executed.

paragraphs.en: Results. AgentOnto Updating correctly handles all 22 feedback events and all 29 requests in each behavioral category, achieving 100.0% on all four metrics. paragraphs.en: The consumer-manufacturing deployment enabled AgentOnto’s Ontology Construction, Ontology-Guided Analysis, and Ontology Updating. Figure 3(a) shows the interface, where AgentOnto analyzes order volume and value and explains consumption patterns. During a one-week observation window, 15 customer accounts completed 144 analytical sessions, in which the system performed 918 data operations. Aggregation result coverage, measured as the proportion of aggregation operations returning a non-empty result, increased from 453/541 (84%) in pre-deployment testing to 106/106 (100%) after deployment with real users. End-to-end latency was typically 30–60 seconds, with a 90th percentile of 46 seconds. AgentOnto therefore supported multi-user, cross-session analytics. We further conducted a controlled task evaluation across three stages. AgentOnto passed 15/19 tasks on the initial set and 20/24 after trend-analysis tasks were added. Following a confirmed ontology update, it passed all 24 tasks. The update added a missing rule for calculating total share across price segments and corrected failures in four scenarios. These results show that ontology rules guide deployed analysis and that targeted updates correct the affected analytical behavior. The consumer manufacturer subsequently integrated a second product-line domain within the same day. This integration added its data and analytical definitions without changing AgentOnto’s core methods, showing how ontology extension supports new domains through the same analysis process.

paragraphs.en: LLM-based data analytics has progressed from prompt-based text-to-SQL toward agents that retrieve context, decompose requests, use database tools, and incorporate execution feedback. Existing methods improve request decomposition, example selection, schema exploration, multi-agent coordination, and execution-guided correction ( Pourreza and Rafiei, 2023 ; Gao et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Deng et al., 2025 ) . Enterprise BI systems further connect these capabilities with enterprise knowledge. SiriusBI ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) retrieves knowledge and produces an intermediate representation, while CoeusBI ( Lian et al., 2026 ) constructs reusable views and compiles a unified query representation. These systems demonstrate the value of context retrieval, tool use, and reusable analytical knowledge. Enterprise knowledge, however, remains distributed across context, prompts, views, and memory. AgentOnto organizes this knowledge as an explicit ontology, uses it throughout analysis, and incorporates confirmed feedback through updates.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型的数据分析已从提示驱动的文本转 SQL 方法，演进为能够检索上下文、分解请求、使用数据库工具并整合执行反馈的智能体。 现有方法改进了请求分解、示例选择、模式探索、多智能体协调以及执行引导的修正（Pourreza and Rafiei, 2023；Gao et al., 2023；Wang et al., 2025；Deng et al., 2025）。 企业商业智能系统进一步将这些能力与企业知识连接起来。 SiriusBI（Jiang et al., 2024）能够检索知识并生成中间表示，而 CoeusBI（Lian et al., 2026）则构建可重用的视图并编译统一的查询表示。 这些系统展示了上下文检索、工具使用以及可重用分析知识的价值。 然而，企业知识仍然分散在上下文、提示、视图和记忆中。 AgentOnto 将这类知识组织为显式本体，在整个分析过程中加以利用，并通过更新整合已确认的反馈。

paragraphs.en: Ontology-based data management organizes domain knowledge and connects it to databases. Ontop ( Calvanese et al., 2016 ) and the OBDA literature ( Xiao et al., 2018 ) combine ontologies, database mappings, and query rewriting. Existing systems make ontology-based access available through terms and natural-language questions ( Blunschi et al., 2012 ; Saha et al., 2016 ; Sen et al., 2020 ; Kharlamov et al., 2017 ) . Analytical semantic layers similarly organize entities, measures, and database relationships for query compilation ( Hyde and Fremlin, 2024 ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Rumiantsau and Fokeev, 2026 ) . AI-assisted ontology engineering uses language models and retrieval to identify concepts, relationships, definitions, and ontology structures from documents and existing knowledge. Representative systems include LLMs4OL ( Giglou et al., 2023 ) , DRAGON-AI ( Toro et al., 2024 ) , OntoChat ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , and methods for generating taxonomies or modular ontologies ( Funk et al., 2023 ; Lo et al., 2024 ; Lippolis et al., 2025 ; Oyewale and Soru, 2026 ) . Towards Agentic Schema Refinement ( Rissaki et al., 2024 ) is closely related to Iterative Ontology Preparation because it generates analysis tasks and validates reusable database views through execution. Other studies apply ontologies to query answering and checking ( Sequeda et al., 2024 ; Allemang and Sequeda, 2024 ) , ontology matching ( Hertling and Paulheim, 2023 ) , and ontology evolution and change management ( Zablith, 2009 ; Tudorache et al., 2013 ; Qiang et al., 2024 ; Noy and Klein, 2004 ; Flouris et al., 2008 ) . These capabilities are formulated as separate processes. AgentOnto integrates Ontology Construction, Ontology-Guided Analysis, and Ontology Updating through an enterprise analytics ontology. Iterative Ontology Preparation examines the ontology through self-generated analysis tasks before actual requests.

paragraphs.en: We presented AgentOnto, an ontology-guided LLM agent that organizes heterogeneous enterprise knowledge into an enterprise analytics ontology, uses the ontology to guide analysis, and incorporates confirmed feedback through targeted updates. Iterative Ontology Preparation further improves the ontology through self-generated analysis tasks. Experiments on two public data sources show that AgentOnto improves overall analysis accuracy and the effectiveness of ontology construction, analysis, and updating, while a real-world deployment demonstrates its practical value. The enterprise analytics ontology connects reusable enterprise knowledge to analytical decisions and allows confirmed improvements to support subsequent requests. These results establish ontology-guided LLM agents as a systematic approach to reliable and adaptable enterprise data analytics.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 AgentOnto，这是一种由本体论引导的大型语言模型智能体，它能够将异构的企业知识组织成企业分析本体论，利用该本体论指导分析，并通过针对性更新整合已确认的反馈。 迭代本体论准备进一步通过自我生成的分析任务来优化本体论。 在两个公开数据源上进行的实验表明，AgentOnto 提高了整体分析准确性以及本体论构建、分析和更新的有效性，而实际部署则证明了其实用价值。 企业分析本体论将可重用的企业知识与分析决策相连接，并允许已确认的改进支持后续请求。 这些结果确立了由本体论引导的大型语言模型智能体是一种实现可靠且适应性强的企业数据分析的系统性方法。
